title.ur: Mukaalma 1: Parhai ke din aur chhuttiyan

intro.en: Rayyan and Mazin talk about the school timetable: how many days we study, which subjects we have, and when the holiday is.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke Rayyan aur Mazin school ke timetable ki baat karte hain: hafte mein kitne din parhai hoti hai, kaun se mazameen hain aur chhutti kab hai.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ رَيّانُ وَمازِنٌ عَنِ الجَدْوَلِ المَدْرَسِيّ: كَمْ يَوْماً نَدْرُس، وَما المَوادّ، وَمَتى الإِجازَة.

dialogue.ar: صَباحَ الخَيْر يا مازِن، اُنْظُرْ إِلى الجَدْوَلِ الجَديدِ عَلى اللَّوْحَة.
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥa l-khayr yā Māzin, unẓur ilā l-jadwali l-jadīdi ʿalā l-lawḥa
dialogue.en: Good morning, Mazin. Look at the new timetable on the board.
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair Mazin, board par naya timetable dekho.

dialogue.ar: نَدْرُسُ خَمْسَةَ أَيّامٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ الأَحَدِ إِلى يَوْمِ الخَمِيس.
dialogue.tr: nadrusu khamsata ayyāmin, min yawmi l-aḥadi ilā yawmi l-khamīs
dialogue.en: We study five days, from Sunday to Thursday.
dialogue.ur: Hum paanch din parhte hain, itwaar se jumerat tak.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْصُلُ على العُطْلَةِ في يَوْمَيِ الجُمُعَةِ وَالسَّبْت.
dialogue.tr: wa naḥṣulu ʿalā l-ʿuṭlati fī yawmayi l-jumuʿati wa s-sabt
dialogue.en: And we get our holiday on Friday and Saturday.
dialogue.ur: Aur humein Jumua aur hafte ke din chhutti milti hai.

dialogue.ar: نَعَم. وَما المَوادُّ الدِّراسِيَّةُ في هَذا الجَدْوَل؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam. wa mā l-mawāddu d-dirāsiyyatu fī hādhā l-jadwal?
dialogue.en: Yes. And what are the school subjects in this timetable?
dialogue.ur: Ji haan. Aur is timetable mein kaun se mazameen hain?

dialogue.ar: الرِّياضِيّاتُ وَالحاسوبُ، ثُمَّ العُلومُ وَاللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ وَالثَّقافَةُ الإِسْلامِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: ar-riyāḍiyyātu wa l-ḥāsūb, thumma l-ʿulūmu wa l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyatu wa th-thaqāfatu l-islāmiyya
dialogue.en: Maths and Computer, then Science, Arabic and Islamic Studies.
dialogue.ur: Riyazi aur computer, phir science, Arabi zubaan aur Islami saqafat.

dialogue.ar: سَأَكْتُبُ هَذِهِ المَوادَّ في دَفْتَري.
dialogue.tr: sa-aktubu hādhihi l-mawādda fī daftarī
dialogue.en: I will write these subjects in my notebook.
dialogue.ur: Main yeh mazameen apni copy mein likhunga.

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَبْدَأُ الاِخْتِباراتُ يا مازِن؟
dialogue.tr: matā tabdaʾu l-ikhtibārātu yā Māzin?
dialogue.en: When do the exams begin, Mazin?
dialogue.ur: Imtihaan kab shuru hote hain, Mazin?

dialogue.ar: تَبْدَأُ في شَهْرِ رَجَب.
dialogue.tr: tabdaʾu fī shahri Rajab
dialogue.en: They begin in the month of Rajab.
dialogue.ur: Rajab ke mahine mein shuru hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَإِلى أَيِّ شَهْرٍ نَدْرُسُ في هَذا العام؟
dialogue.tr: wa ilā ayyi shahrin nadrusu fī hādhā l-ʿām?
dialogue.en: And until which month do we study this year?
dialogue.ur: Aur is saal hum kis mahine tak parhte hain?

dialogue.ar: يَنْتَهي العامُ في شَهْرِ شَعْبان، ثُمَّ تَأْتي العُطْلَةُ الطَّويلَة.
dialogue.tr: yantahī l-ʿāmu fī shahri Shaʿbān, thumma taʾtī l-ʿuṭlatu ṭ-ṭawīla
dialogue.en: The year ends in the month of Shaban, then the long holiday comes.
dialogue.ur: Saal Shaban ke mahine mein khatam hota hai, phir lambi chhutti aati hai.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ شَهْراً العُطْلَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: kam shahran l-ʿuṭla?
dialogue.en: How many months is the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Chhutti kitne mahine ki hai?

dialogue.ar: العُطْلَةُ شَهْرانِ يا رَيّان، الحَمْدُ لله.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿuṭlatu shahrāni yā Rayyān, al-ḥamdu li-llāh
dialogue.en: The holiday is two months, Rayyan, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Chhutti do mahine ki hai Rayyan, alhamdulillah.

dialogue.ar: جاءَ المُعَلِّمُ، وَبَدَأَتِ الحِصَّة. هَيّا إِلى الصَّفِّ يا مازِن.
dialogue.tr: jāʾa l-muʿallimu, wa badaʾati l-ḥiṣṣa. hayyā ilā ṣ-ṣaffi yā Māzin
dialogue.en: The teacher has come and the lesson has begun. Let's go to class, Mazin.
dialogue.ur: Ustaad aa gaye aur period shuru ho gaya. Chalo class mein Mazin.

q.en: How many study days are there in the week?
q.ur: Hafte mein parhai ke kitne din hain?
Chhutti ke din kaun se hain?
«حِصَّة» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: In which month do the exams begin?
q.ur: Imtihaan kis mahine mein shuru hote hain?
"Computer" ke liye lafz kaun sa hai?

intro.en: Huda and Rana meet and talk about where they are from and what they study. Notice the girl's ending: طالِبَة (a female student) and سُورِيَّة (Syrian, female).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke Huda aur Rana apna taaruf karti hain aur batati hain ke woh kahan aur kya parhti hain. Dhyan dein: ladki ke liye lafz ke aakhir mein ة aata hai, jaise طالِبَة.
intro.ar: تَلْتَقي هُدى وَرَنا وَتَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ بَلَدَيْهِما وَما تَدْرُسانِه. نُلاحِظُ نِهايَةَ المُؤَنَّث: طالِبَة وَسُورِيَّة.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم، أَنا هُدى.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum, anā Hudā
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, I am Huda.
dialogue.ur: Assalamu alaikum, main Huda hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ يا هُدى. أَنا رَنا، تَشَرَّفْنا.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salāmu yā Hudā. anā Ranā, tasharrafnā
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace, Huda. I am Rana, pleased to meet you.
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam Huda. Main Rana hoon, mil kar khushi hui.

dialogue.ar: أَنا سُعودِيَّة، وَأَنْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: anā suʿūdiyya, wa anti?
dialogue.en: I am Saudi, and you?
dialogue.ur: Main Saudi hoon, aur aap?

dialogue.ar: أَنا سُورِيَّةٌ مِنْ حَلَب.
dialogue.tr: anā sūriyyatun min Ḥalab
dialogue.en: I am Syrian, from Aleppo.
dialogue.ur: Main Shaam (Syria) ki hoon, Halab se.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تَدْرُسينَ في هَذِهِ الجامِعَة؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal tadrusīna fī hādhihi l-jāmiʿa?
dialogue.en: And do you study at this university?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap isi jamia mein parhti hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، أَدْرُسُ في جامِعَةِ حَلَب. وَأَنْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam, adrusu fī jāmiʿati Ḥalab. wa anti?
dialogue.en: Yes, I study at Aleppo University. And you?
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main Halab ki jamia mein parhti hoon. Aur aap?

dialogue.ar: جامِعَتي هِيَ جامِعَةُ المَلِكِ سُعود في الرِّياض.
dialogue.tr: jāmiʿatī hiya jāmiʿatu l-maliki Suʿūd fī r-Riyāḍ
dialogue.en: My university is King Saud University in Riyadh.
dialogue.ur: Meri jamia Jamia Malik Saud hai, Riyadh mein.

dialogue.ar: ما الكُلِّيَّةُ التي تَدْرُسينَ فيها؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-kulliyyatu llatī tadrusīna fīhā?
dialogue.en: Which college do you study in?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis college mein parhti hain?

dialogue.ar: أَدْرُسُ الطِّبَّ، وَكُلِّيَّتي هِيَ كُلِّيَّةُ الطِّبّ. وَأَنْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: adrusu ṭ-ṭibba, wa kulliyyatī hiya kulliyyatu ṭ-ṭibb. wa anti?
dialogue.en: I study medicine, and my college is the College of Medicine. And you?
dialogue.ur: Main Tibb parhti hoon, aur mera college Tibb ka college hai. Aur aap?

dialogue.ar: أَمّا أَنا فَكُلِّيَّتي هِيَ كُلِّيَّةُ التَّرْبِيَة.
dialogue.tr: ammā anā fa-kulliyyatī hiya kulliyyatu t-tarbiya
dialogue.en: As for me, my college is the College of Education.
dialogue.ur: Rahi main, to mera college Tarbiyat ka college hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنْ شاءَ الله سَأَكونُ طَبيبَةً ماهِرَة.
dialogue.tr: in shāʾa llāh sa-akūnu ṭabībatan māhira
dialogue.en: In shaa Allah I will be a skilled doctor.
dialogue.ur: In shaa Allah main ek mahir doctor banungi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا، إِنْ شاءَ الله، سَأَكونُ مُدَرِّسَةً ناجِحَة.
dialogue.tr: wa anā, in shāʾa llāh, sa-akūnu mudarrisatan nājiḥa
dialogue.en: And I, in shaa Allah, will be a successful teacher.
dialogue.ur: Aur main, in shaa Allah, kaamyab ustaani banungi.

q.ur: Huda kahan parhti hai?

q.en: What will Rana be, God willing?
q.ur: Rana, in shaa Allah, kya banegi?
q.ar: ماذا سَتَكونُ رَنا إِنْ شاءَ الله؟

q.ur: «إِنْ شاءَ الله» ka matlab kya hai?
"University" ke liye lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما اسْمُ المَكانِ الكَبيرِ الذي فيهِ كُلِّيّات؟

intro.en: Nawwaf asks Yasir where he is going, how he gets there and how long his school day is. You will learn the time, the library and the lab.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke Nawwaf, Yasir se poochta hai woh kahan jaa raha hai, kaise jaata hai aur uska school ka din kitna lamba hai. Hum waqt, library aur lab ke alfaaz bhi seekhenge.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ نَوّافٌ ياسِراً إِلى أَيْنَ يَذْهَب، وَكَيْفَ يَصِل، وَكَمْ حِصَّةً عِنْدَه. نَتَعَلَّمُ الوَقْتَ وَالمَكْتَبَةَ وَالمُخْتَبَر.

dialogue.ar: يا ياسِر، إِلى أَيِّ مَكانٍ تَذْهَبُ في هَذا الصَّباح؟
dialogue.tr: yā Yāsir, ilā ayyi makānin tadhhabu fī hādhā ṣ-ṣabāḥ?
dialogue.en: Yasir, to which place are you going this morning?
dialogue.ur: Yasir, tum aaj subah kis jagah ja rahe ho?

dialogue.ar: أَنا ذاهِبٌ إِلى المَدْرَسَة. هَلْ تَعْرِفُ كَمِ السّاعَةُ الآنَ؟
dialogue.tr: anā dhāhibun ilā l-madrasa. hal taʿrifu kami s-sāʿatu l-ān?
dialogue.en: I am going to school. Do you know what time it is now?
dialogue.ur: Main school ja raha hoon. Kya tumhein pata hai abhi kitne baje hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، نَظَرْتُ إِلى ساعَتي الآنَ، وَهِيَ السّابِعَةُ صَباحاً.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, naẓartu ilā sāʿatī l-āna, wa hiya s-sābiʿatu ṣabāḥan
dialogue.en: Yes, I just looked at my watch, and it is seven in the morning.
dialogue.ur: Haan, maine abhi apni ghari dekhi, subah ke saat baje hain.

dialogue.ar: بَيْتي بَعيدٌ عَنْ مَدْرَسَتي، وَلِذلِكَ أَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ مُبَكِّراً.
dialogue.tr: baytī baʿīdun ʿan madrasatī, wa lidhālika akhruju mina l-bayti mubakkirā
dialogue.en: My house is far from my school, so I leave the house early.
dialogue.ur: Mera ghar meri school se door hai, isliye main ghar se jaldi nikalta hoon.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَذْهَبُ بِالسَّيّارَة؟
dialogue.tr: hal tadhhabu bi-s-sayyāra?
dialogue.en: Do you go by car?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum car mein jaate ho?

dialogue.ar: لا، أَرْكَبُ الحافِلَةَ كُلَّ صَباح.
dialogue.tr: lā, arkabu l-ḥāfilata kulla ṣabāḥ
dialogue.en: No, I ride the bus every morning.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, main roz subah bus mein jaata hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَمَتى تَبْدَأُ الحِصَّةُ الأولى؟
dialogue.tr: wa matā tabdaʾu l-ḥiṣṣatu l-ūlā?
dialogue.en: And when does the first lesson begin?
dialogue.ur: Aur pehla period kab shuru hota hai?

dialogue.ar: تَبْدَأُ في السّاعَةِ الثّامِنَة.
dialogue.tr: tabdaʾu fī s-sāʿati th-thāmina
dialogue.en: It begins at eight o'clock.
dialogue.ur: Aath baje shuru hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَتى تَنْتَهي الحِصَص؟
dialogue.tr: wa matā tantahī l-ḥiṣaṣ?
dialogue.en: And when do the lessons end?
dialogue.ur: Aur period kab khatam hote hain?

dialogue.ar: وَتَنْتَهي حِصَصُنا عِنْدَ السّاعَةِ الثّانِيَةِ ظُهْراً.
dialogue.tr: wa tantahī ḥiṣaṣunā ʿinda s-sāʿati th-thāniyati ẓuhran
dialogue.en: And our lessons end at two in the afternoon.
dialogue.ur: Aur hamare period dopahar do baje khatam hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكَمْ حِصَّةً تَأْخُذونَ كُلَّ يَوْم؟
dialogue.tr: wa kam ḥiṣṣatan taʾkhudhūna kulla yawm?
dialogue.en: And how many lessons do you take each day?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap roz kitne period lete hain?

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَنا خَمْسُ حِصَص.
dialogue.tr: ʿindanā khamsu ḥiṣaṣ
dialogue.en: We have five lessons.
dialogue.ur: Hamare paanch period hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ في الاِسْتِراحَة؟
dialogue.tr: wa ayna tadhhabu fī l-istirāḥa?
dialogue.en: And where do you go at break?
dialogue.ur: Aur tum break mein kahan jaate ho?

dialogue.ar: أُحِبُّ المُخْتَبَر، وَأَقْرَأُ في المَكْتَبَةِ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: uḥibbu l-mukhtabar, wa aqraʾu fī l-maktabati ayḍan
dialogue.en: I love the lab, and I read in the library too.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe lab pasand hai, aur main library mein bhi parhta hoon.

q.ur: Yasir kahan jaata hai?

q.en: How does Yasir go to school?
q.ur: Yasir school kaise jaata hai?

q.en: How many lessons does Yasir have a day?
q.ur: Yasir ke din mein kitne period hote hain?
q.ar: كَمْ حِصَّةً عِنْدَ ياسِرٍ في اليَوْم؟

q.ur: "Library" ke liye lafz kaun sa hai?
"Kab?" poochne ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الزَّمَن؟

intro.en: Practise the words of the first three dialogues, singular and plural, and learn the ordinal numbers: first, second, third... up to tenth.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum pichhle mukaalmon ke alfaaz ki mashq karenge (wahid aur jama), aur tarteebi adaad seekhenge: pehla, doosra, teesra... dasvan tak.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ على كَلِماتِ الحِواراتِ الثَّلاثَةِ الأولى بِالمُفْرَدِ وَالجَمْع، وَنَتَعَلَّمُ الأَعْدادَ التَّرْتيبِيَّةَ: الأُولى، الثّانِيَة، الثّالِثَة... إِلى العاشِرَة.

q.ur: «يَوْم» ki jama kya hai?
«شَهْر» ki jama kya hai?
«السّابِعَة» ka matlab:
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ على التَّرْتيبِ رَقْم ٧؟

q.ur: "Pehli" ke liye lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ على التَّرْتيبِ رَقْم ١؟

q.ur: «غُرْفَة» ki jama kya hai?

intro.en: Learn useful patterns: "X is far from Y", "I will be a teacher", "I am a student at...", "In which university do you study?" and the commands: write, read, drink, wash.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum kaam ke jumle seekhenge: "X, Y se door hai", "Main ustaad banoonga", "Main ... mein talib-ilm hoon", "Aap kis jamia mein parhte hain?" aur hukm wale alfaaz: likho, parho, piyo, dho.
intro.ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ تَراكيبَ مُفيدَة: «المَدْرَسَةُ بَعيدَةٌ عَنِ البَيْت»، «سَأَكونُ مُدَرِّساً»، «أَنا طالِبٌ في…»، «في أَيِّ جامِعَةٍ تَدْرُس؟»، وَأَفْعالَ الأَمْر: اُكْتُبْ، اِقْرَأْ، اِشْرَبْ، اِغْسِلْ.

vocab.en: the school is far from the house
I am a student at Damascus University
vocab.ur: main Damishq jamia ka talib-ilm hoon

vocab.en: in which university do you study?
vocab.ur: aap kis jamia mein parhte hain?
usne likha / woh likhta hai / likho!
usne piya / woh peeta hai / piyo!
usne parha / woh parhta hai / parho!
usne dhoya / woh dhota hai / dho!
usne suna / woh sunta hai / suno!
usne jhaadu di / woh jhaadu deta hai / jhaadu do!
usne dekha / woh dekhta hai / dekho!

q.en: Choose the correct sentence: "The school is far from the house."
q.ur: Sahi jumla chunein: "School ghar se door hai."
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ الجُمْلَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ في بُعْدِ المَدْرَسَةِ عَنِ البَيْت.

q.en: A girl says "I will be a teacher". Which is right?
q.ur: Ek ladki kehti hai "main ustaani banoongi". Sahi jumla kaun sa hai?
q.ar: تَقولُ بِنْتٌ إِنَّها سَتَكونُ مُعَلِّمَة. أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ صَحيحَة؟

q.ur: Hukm "Parho!" ye hai:
«يَشْرَبُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which question means "In which university do you study?" (to a man)
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal hai "aap kis jamia mein parhte hain?" (mard se)
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَنِ الجامِعَةِ التي يَدْرُسُ فيها الطّالِب (لِلْمُذَكَّر).

intro.en: Listen and repeat the deep throaty sound غ (Ghayn). Compare it with ق (Qaf) so that you hear the difference, then listen to Quran verses that contain غ.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum harf غ (Ghayn) ki halq wali awaaz sunenge aur dohrayenge. Phir ق (Qaf) se uska farq sunenge aur Quran ki aayaat mein غ ko pehchanenge.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى صَوْتِ حَرْفِ الغَيْنِ العَميقِ وَنُكَرِّرُه، وَنُقارِنُهُ بِحَرْفِ القافِ لِنَسْمَعَ الفَرْق، ثُمَّ نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى آياتٍ فيها غَيْن.

q.en: Which letter is shown in this lesson?
q.ur: Is sabaq mein kaun sa harf hai?

q.en: Which name begins with the letter غ?
q.ur: Kaun sa naam غ se shuru hota hai?
«قالَ» kis harf se shuru hota hai?
"Us ne kaha" ke liye lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ الفِعْلُ الماضي مِنَ القَوْل؟

intro.en: Listen to the questions about Ahmad's day and practise asking and answering with a friend: where do you study, how many lessons, where do you go?
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Ahmad ke din ke baare mein sawal sunenge aur dost ke saath poochne aur jawab dene ki mashq karenge: aap kahan parhte hain, kitne period, kahan jaate hain?
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى أَسْئِلَةٍ عَنْ يَوْمِ أَحْمَد، وَنَتَدَرَّبُ مَعَ صَديقٍ على السُّؤالِ وَالجَواب: أَيْنَ تَدْرُس؟ كَمْ حِصَّةً؟ إِلى أَيْنَ تَذْهَب؟

vocab.en: how many days a week do you study?
vocab.ur: aap hafte mein kitne din parhte hain?
woh fajr ki namaz parhta hai

q.en: How do you ask "When does Ahmad wake up?"
q.ur: "Ahmad kab jaagta hai?" kaise poochenge?
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَنْ وَقْتِ اسْتِيقاظِ أَحْمَد.

q.en: Which question asks "Where does Ahmad pray Fajr?"
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal hai "Ahmad fajr kahan parhta hai?"
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَنْ مَكانِ صَلاةِ أَحْمَدَ الفَجْر.

q.en: Answer «هَلْ تَذْهَبُ بِالسَّيّارَة؟» (Do you go by car?) with "No, by bus".
q.ur: Jawab dein: «هَلْ تَذْهَبُ بِالسَّيّارَة؟» (kya aap car se jaate hain?) "Nahin, bus se".
q.ar: أَجِبْ بِـ«لا» عَنْ سُؤالِ «هَلْ تَذْهَبُ بِالسَّيّارَة؟» وَاذْكُرِ الحافِلَة.

q.en: «كَمْ يَوْماً تَدْرُسُ في الأُسْبوع؟» asks about:
q.ur: «كَمْ يَوْماً تَدْرُسُ في الأُسْبوع؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: عَمّا تَسْأَلُ جُمْلَةُ «كَمْ يَوْماً تَدْرُسُ في الأُسْبوع؟»

options: Number of study days / Parhai ke dinon ki tadaad
Number of lessons / Periodon ki tadaad

intro.en: Read words and sentences carefully, then read a short paragraph about Maryam, a university student, and answer the questions.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum alfaaz aur jumle dhyan se parhenge, phir Maryam ke baare mein ek chhota sa paragraph parh kar sawalon ke jawab denge. Maryam ek jamia ki talibah hai.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ كَلِماتٍ وَجُمَلاً بِعِنايَة، ثُمَّ نَقْرَأُ فِقْرَةً قَصيرَةً عَنْ مَرْيَم، طالِبَةٍ في الجامِعَة، وَنُجيبُ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة.

vocab.ar: أُخْتي مَرْيَمُ طالِبَةٌ في جامِعَةِ دِمَشْق
vocab.tr: ukhtī Maryamu ṭālibatun fī jāmiʿati Dimashq
vocab.en: my sister Maryam is a student at Damascus University
vocab.ur: meri behan Maryam Damishq jamia ki talibah hai

vocab.en: she studies in the College of Medicine
vocab.ur: woh tibb ki kulliyah mein parhti hai

q.ur: Maryam kahan parhti hai?

q.en: What will Maryam be, God willing?
q.ur: Maryam, insha Allah, kya banegi?
q.ar: ماذا سَتَكونُ مَرْيَمُ إِنْ شاءَ الله؟

q.en: How does Maryam go to the university?
q.ur: Maryam jamia kaise jaati hai?

q.en: Is Maryam's apartment far from the university?
q.ur: Kya Maryam ka flat jamia se door hai?
q.ar: هَلْ شَقَّةُ مَرْيَمَ بَعيدَةٌ عَنِ الجامِعَة؟

intro.en: Learn to write لا and لأ, the letter و and the long vowel sound, the short vowels (fatha, damma, kasra, sukun) and the tanween endings.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum لا aur لأ likhna, harf و aur madd ki awaaz, chhoti harkaat (fatha, damma, kasra, sukoon) aur tanween seekhenge.
intro.ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ كِتابَةَ «لا» وَ«لأ» وَحَرْفِ الواوِ وَحَرَكَةِ المَدّ، وَالحَرَكاتِ القَصيرَةِ (الفَتْحَة وَالضَّمَّة وَالكَسْرَة وَالسُّكون) وَالتَّنْوين.

q.en: Which one has the tanween of nasb (accusative)?
q.ur: Tanween-e-nasb kis mein hai?
«أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً» kab kehte hain?

options: Welcome a guest / Mehman ka istiqbal karne ke liye
Say goodbye / Ruksat hone ke liye
Ask the time / Waqt poochne ke liye
Ask a name / Naam poochne ke liye

q.ur: "Hafta" ke liye lafz kaun sa hai?

q.en: Which word starts with the letter و?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz harf و se shuru hota hai?
